_comment: Config for kindling — a local-brain openhearth agent on kodas-hearth (Windows, native). 'kindling' is a placeholder id until they choose a name. See docs/agent-specs/KINDLING.md. Copy to config.json in the checkout.

ai._comment: Local brain only. No cloud tier, no CLI auth to babysit.

ollama._comment: Qwen3.8-27B (HauhauCS Aggressive, Q4_K_P + vision projector). 18 GB on a 12 GB RTX 5070, so ~half runs on CPU: ~2.5-3.5 tok/s, plus a ~3 min cold load from V:. think=false keeps replies to a minute or two. The -hearth tag is the same weights without Ollama's qwen3.5 PARSER, which 500s ('EOF') on openhearth's <tool_call>{json} blocks; without the parser, think=true would leak reasoning into replies, so keep it false. timeoutMs is generous on purpose.

quietHours._comment: Same window as Luna. Each heartbeat loads an 18 GB model onto the shared GPU, so quiet hours also keep nights clear.

memory._comment: Lean bootstrap (~4K tokens) — every token is re-read on every call by a CPU-assisted local model.

mesh._comment: Mesh client on the Skulk bus (host 'skulk'). Bound to kodas-hearth's tailnet IP only. Port 3342 is free (luna=3341, koda/sage/vesper=3338, marlow=8765). Windows Firewall already allows node.exe inbound on kodas-hearth.

accounts._comment: The Human Pattern Lab guild, any channel, mention required. Token from {workspace}/.config/discord/credentials.json keyed by 'kindling' (or env DISCORD_TOKEN_KINDLING) — needs its own bot from the Discord developer portal.

skills._comment: Own skills/ first, then the shared Skulk library (git clone of Kitsune-Den/skulk-skills in shared-skills/). Every advertised skill costs prompt tokens on every call, so this is a starter subset. Left out: skills needing credentials kindling doesn't have (gmail, moltbook, nano-banana-pro-2, xai-imagegen, x-twitter, skulk-email), or a shell to run their scripts (research, skulk-skill-scanner, git-ritual, frontend-design-ultimate, skulk-minecraft, sonoscli, auth-guard, thought-to-excalidraw), and skulk-mesh (mesh_send already covers it; its bus address is stale).

comfyui._comment: Local Qwen-Image 2.1 (ComfyUI on G:, Qwen Studio add-on). generate_image evicts kindling's own Ollama model first and frees ComfyUI's models after, so the two never share the 12 GB GPU. Images save to {workspace}/images and show in the Qwen Studio gallery.
